**Finding submitted — deviation (NOSOLICIT).**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 9.0(f) (p0189) is the only non-solicitation/no-hire language in the document (searches for "solicit", "hire/employ/induce", and all "Transferred Employees" references confirmed no other covenant, and nothing cross-references 9.0(f)).
- **Why it fails fallback:** it binds only IBM (no mutuality), covers all Transferred Employees regardless of involvement in the work, and runs for a period of years from the Effective Date rather than 12 months after involvement ends. The general-advertising and unsolicited-contact carve-outs exist, and it is not a no-hire — noted, but not curative.
- **Cure:** one surgical replace at the preferred level converting the covenant into a short confirmation that IBM may solicit or employ Transferred Employees (whole-paragraph deletion was rejected by the minimality gate; the retained search-firm proviso would otherwise have been a contradictory residual restriction). Mutual 12-month fallback offered in the comment.
